name: secret-dj
description: Secret DJ - a real-time listening party where you guess who queued the track.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @secret-dj/common && npm run build -w @secret-dj/backend && npm run build -w @secret-dj/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @secret-dj/common && (npm run dev -w @secret-dj/common & npm run dev -w @secret-dj/backend & npm run dev -w @secret-dj/frontend & wait)
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
